plan.summary: Fix two FlowBuilder wizard bugs: (1) AI-generated flow configs in ```json blocks not extracted (only ```flowconfig was matched), causing 'Uygula' banner to never appear; (2) WizardChat missing option button rendering and wizard-store ignoring event.options.
plan.q_intent: flow builder da. son adım da oluşturmuyor flowu. ayrıca kullanıcıya sorulan sorular düzgün düğme olarak gösterilmiyor.

files_changed.change: ExtractFlowConfig now matches ```json blocks, StripCodeBlocks strips FlowConfigV2 ```json blocks, extracted ValidateFlowConfigJson helper
Added content field to done SSE event
Added pendingOptions state, extract options from done event, strip streaming blocks
Updated stripCodeBlocks/stripStreamingBlocks to handle ```json FlowConfigV2 blocks
Added option button rendering with handleOptionClick
Updated cleanAssistantText to strip ```json FlowConfigV2 blocks

verification_questions.question: Does ExtractFlowConfig correctly match both ```flowconfig and ```json blocks containing valid FlowConfigV2?
Are code blocks properly stripped from display text in all paths (streaming, done event, message history)?
Do option buttons render correctly in WizardChat and are they wired to sendMessage?

intentional_exclusions: SimulationPanel already has option buttons — no changes needed there

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All JSON parse failures return null/false gracefully, falling back to existing behavior

aha_moments.suggestion: Extract and display flow configs regardless of code block format (```json or ```flowconfig)

aha_moments.suggestion: Show clickable option buttons below AI questions in WizardChat

aha_moments.user_pain: Creating a flow requires multiple typed messages back and forth
aha_moments.suggestion: One-click option selection speeds up the wizard conversation flow
